# Chapter 11 · General M- and Z-Estimation {.unnumbered}
*Uniform Convergence · Consistency · Local Linearization · Sandwich Asymptotics*

OLS의 closed-form representation을 일반화하여 population optimization problem과 population estimating equation이 sample estimator와 어떻게 연결되고, 어떤 조건에서 consistency와 root-$n$ asymptotic normality가 성립하는지 체계적으로 정리한다.

## Chapter Map

::: {.callout-note title="Reading Roadmap"}
- **11.1–11.4** OLS에서 M/Z-estimation으로, pointwise vs uniform convergence, M-consistency
- **11.5–11.7** ULLN, Z-consistency, local identification과 Jacobian/curvature
- **11.8–11.10** smooth M/Z asymptotics, influence representation, sandwich variance
- **11.11–11.14** approximate/nonsmooth solutions, examples, limits, 요약과 연습문제
:::
